title: Cloud File Sharing (HMAC download tokens)
oneLine: Flask + object storage + notify function: HMAC-signed expiring download links and auto-delete after every recipient downloads.
role: Solo CS532 coursework project — design, Flask app, Lambda notify, IAM templates, fake-AWS unit tests.
limitations: Static simulation only. Coursework tree is not a git repo, so DEMO=1 was documented not patched. As-checked-in unittest discover fails TemplateNotFound unless HTML files sit under templates/ next to app.py; logic tests pass in a /tmp layout. No live AWS or email. Absolute evidence paths stay in a private evidence note, not in this public package.
